create_VideoRecorder: create a VideoRecorder instance with a root directory, render size, and fps for evaluation video recording
run_VideoRecorder_init: run VideoRecorder init to start recording frames from a gym environment with optional enable flag
run_VideoRecorder_record: run VideoRecorder record to capture a single frame from an environment using physics render or env render
run_VideoRecorder_save: run VideoRecorder save to write collected frames to a video file using imageio at the configured fps
create_TrainVideoRecorder: create a TrainVideoRecorder instance with a root directory, render size, and fps for training video recording
